title: Anyway wordmarks — round 02
purpose: Six refined software wordmarks presented enlarged and in dark documentation headers.

boards.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design a polished, thoughtfully art-directed wordmark comparison board for the brand "Anyway".
Image 1 is a CONTEXT REFERENCE ONLY: a real dark documentation website with a handwritten Anyway logo at top left, a slash followed by "docs", centered search, and GitHub at the right. We are designing a new text-only brand identity for a family of carefully designed software apps. The existing thin handwritten signature feels too delicate. The new wordmarks need personality, excellent small-size legibility and the finish of custom professional typography. Do not copy the old handwriting.
Make a NEW square 1536x1536 presentation image, with THREE equally sized horizontal concept panels stacked vertically. Background flat dark charcoal close to the reference website, with quiet thin gray separators. Every panel has: a tiny gray concept label at top left; a large exquisitely drawn white wordmark centered in the upper-middle region; and beneath it a realistic full-width compact website HEADER STRIP showing the exact same design at actual nav-logo proportions. This small header provides scale and context.
The miniature header is restrained and precise: at left, the new Anyway wordmark in white, a thin muted slash, then "docs" in small neutral sans-serif; a quiet rounded search box in the center labeled "Search" with a small command key hint; and "GitHub" on the right. Keep enough space around the logo so it feels comfortable at navigation size. The large logo should occupy roughly 500-650px of the 1536px board width; no oversized display type spanning the whole sheet. Logo letters should be identifiable in the small header as well. Both versions of a given logo must be the SAME lettering.
No hero heading, no buttons, no texture, no photographs, no decorative icons, no standalone brand mark. Only typography and the simple nav context. No gradients, shadows, mockup perspective or explanatory paragraphs. White lettering on dark charcoal. Preserve the brand spelling: A N Y W A Y, six letters, in the case specified. Have a strong coherent silhouette and beautifully balanced kerning. Each concept must look clearly different from its neighbors, not just a weight adjustment. This is refined software brand design, with inventive letterforms that still read immediately.

Top panel label: "25 / OPEN". Logo text "anyway". A confident bespoke HUMANIST SANS in medium-semibold weight. Open double-storey a letters, a tall x-height, generous round counters, compact but not tight spacing. The w is a subtly asymmetric pair of soft diagonals; the y has an unexpectedly graceful short curved descending terminal. Straight upright stems with very subtly softened corners. It feels calm, intelligent, welcoming and designed by a serious independent app studio. Avoid swollen bubble forms and generic geometric sans.
Middle panel label: "26 / JOIN". Logo text "anyway". A distinct custom GEOMETRIC SANS in substantial medium weight, using single-storey a letters with round bowls and crisp angled shoulder cuts. A particularly memorable diagonal y-w relationship with matching notches and a little purposeful negative space. Crisp flat-ended terminals and round/diagonal tension. Slightly wider than OPEN. No letters disappear into abstract symbols: all six letters immediately readable. Contemporary, precise, original.
Bottom panel label: "27 / FORWARD". Logo text "Anyway". A tightly drawn SEMIBOLD OBLIQUE GROTESK with a restrained 9-degree forward inclination, robust strokes, crisp cut terminals, a confident capital A and an elegant descending y. A subtle bespoke join between w and a, without a ligature that loses letters. Compact and spirited, like an exquisitely engineered app with personality. NO handwriting, brushwork, script or swashes.

Top panel label: "28 / EDITORIAL". Logo text "Anyway". A sturdy contemporary FLARED SERIF wordmark, upright, medium bold, LOW stroke contrast so it survives in a small nav. The A has tiny wedge feet, a narrow bright counter and a distinctive low crossbar. Lowercase letters have broad open interiors and gently concave flared stems. A beautifully shaped, compact descending final y. Sophisticated and warm, balancing the reference website's italic serif hero with more grounded branding. No thin fashion serifs, calligraphy or script.
Middle panel label: "29 / STUDIO MONO". Logo text "anyway". An elegant custom MONOSPACED HUMANIST SANS with mechanical consistency and subtle character. Medium-bold weight, crisp rounded rectangular counters, unmistakable double-storey a letters, a gently hooked y, and a wide but disciplined w. Very tiny terminal details, NO slab serifs, no typewriter nostalgia. Feel like a lovingly crafted developer tool rather than a terminal prompt. Keep the exact six-letter word clean and easy to read.
Bottom panel label: "30 / SOFT SQUARE". Logo text "anyway". An original substantial lowercase ROUNDED SQUARE wordmark, drawing its rhythm from rectangular app controls. Wide open square-round counters, thick but not bloated strokes, open n arch, single-storey a letters, a sculptural w and unusual y with a shallow bowl and tidy diagonal descender. Distinctive but grown up. Slightly compact proportions, smooth outer corners and crisp inner cuts. Avoid the gummy bubble-letter look; this should be refined functional software branding.
